answer: Each agent must run a live relay node on its own public IP all epoch. The registry pings each node every 10 minutes, 144 heartbeats a day; a node that misses 3 is ejected and its rewards frozen. Replies slower than 200 milliseconds count as missed, so a node drifting in like a zephyr still fails. Nodes sharing one ASN are capped at 5, so one datacenter cannot hide 100 clones, and a comet burst of fake traffic cannot survive a day of pings. Each node costs $6 a month, so 100 fakes cost $600 a month before earning anything. Like a ferrous chain, it holds only if every link keeps answering.
